summary: Eleanor Heller, writing on behalf of the Mazamas conservation organization, expresses support for the proposed ORV regulations, finding the draft environmental statement generally good. She advocates that all public off-road recreation lands and trails should default to closed for ORV use, with only selected areas posted as open, arguing this approach would be easier to enforce than posting closures. She is relieved that federal agencies have recognized the incompatibility of motorized ORV use with quiet recreational activities such as hiking, backpacking, and horseback riding.
